objective: Bring Kum'isha Imperfect Draenethyst Fragments and be rewarded for each one you turn in.

description: Although you may never find a flawless sphere of draenethyst, you will undoubtedly uncover various imperfect fragments of the draenethyst in your exploration of these lands.
While it is doubtful that Kum'isha will be able to use the flawed fragments to return home, the pieces may serve other, useful purposes for the draenei.
Return any piece of flawed draenethyst fragments that you may find and I shall reward you.
progress: Have you had any luck in your exploration?
completion: You truly disgust me, <race>. A grown man drooling over a pile of junk? Pitiful! Take your reward and get out of my sight.
